title: Boss: The Reflected Page
story: A search page prints the user's text back. A visitor typed a script tag instead.
goal: Fix render(q) so text from the user is escaped before it goes into HTML.
hints: Escape q, not the whole string, and keep the quotes setting on.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
